Quick update for the team before I log off.
Most of today went into the offline sync work.
This morning, I finally tracked down the crash we saw on Monday.
It only happened when the device lost its connection in the middle of an upload,
and the retry logic kept the old request around.
So the second attempt sent an expired token, and the server rejected it.
The fix was smaller than I expected, about 40 lines, but I rewrote the retry helper so
it builds a fresh request every time instead of reusing the old one.
I added unit tests for the three failure cases we know about, and they all pass locally.
I pushed the branch around three and opened a pull request against develop.
The build is green, but I'd like a second pair of eyes on the error handling before we merge,
because it touches the login flow as well.
After that, I spent an hour on the settings screen.
The toggle for haptic feedback wasn't saving its state after a restart, which turned out
to be a typo in the preferences key.
That one is already merged.
Tomorrow morning, I'm going to profile memory usage in the keyboard extension, since we're
getting close to the limit again.
And in the afternoon, I'll write the release notes for the next beta.
If anyone has time before noon, please review the sync pull request.
Thanks, and have a good evening.

Quick update for the team before I log off.
Most of today went into the offline sync work.
This morning, I finally tracked down the crash we saw on Monday.
It only happened when the device lost its connection
in the middle of an upload,
and the retry logic kept the old request around.
So the second attempt sent an expired token
and the server rejected it.
The fix was smaller than I expected, about 40 lines.
But I rewrote the retry helper so it builds a fresh request every time, instead of reusing the old one.
I added unit tests for the three failure cases we know about, and they all pass locally.
I pushed the branch around three, and opened a pull request against develop.
The build is green, but I'd like a second pair of eyes on the error handling before we merge,
because it touches the login flow as well.
After that, I spent an hour on the settings screen.
The toggle for haptic feedback wasn't saving its state after a restart,
which turned out to be a typo in the preferences key.
That one is already merged.
Tomorrow morning, I'm going to profile memory usage in the keyboard extension,
since we're getting close to the limit again.
And in the afternoon, I'll write the release notes for the next beta.
